question: For Rank #1 candidates, do earlier observable dips have better remaining-session returns than later dips?
cohort_separation: Never pool research models, actual saved picks, lower ranks or repeated clock observations as independent Rank #1 examples.

availability.basis: User-directed early availability after actual session opening price is observed. Recorded run timestamps are diagnostic, not guaranteed first publication.

return_definition: expected final regular-minute close / actual entry-minute open - 1; no expense subtraction
first_event: First completed regular-minute close at/below96% of anchor whose next minute begins at/after assumed ranking availability and before session close; enter immediately consecutive minute open. A missing exact next minute is unavailable, with no later retry.
onset: First observed completed-bar threshold close over the entire session, reported at bar END; separate from tradable entry after availability. Prior-close opening gaps are separately flagged and never called fast post-open declines.
checkpoint_execution: At checkpoint t, observe immediately preceding completed minute close and enter at exact checkpoint minute open, if t>=availability and t<session close. Opening09:30 is a reference, not an executable ranked checkpoint.
early_late_definition: Primary first-event entries before10:30 versus10:30 and later, with separate depth strata. Also report onset timing to avoid relabeling pre-availability dips as late dips.
metrics: unique stock-days and sessions and ISO weeks
worst observed further downside after entry
equal-cash opportunity mean for first-event rules with unavailable excluded explicitly

uncertainty.method: nonparametric bootstrap of whole ISO calendar-week clusters within each cohort/anchor/group; preserve all repeated observations in each resampled week
uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive pointwise intervals, no multiple-comparison correction and no causal or prospective-edge claim.

data_rules: No named ticker exclusions. No forward fills or fabricated entry/exit values. Require valid raw current session opening minute, exact signal/entry bars and expected final exit minute. Reject duplicate/nonfinite/inconsistent OHLC. Missing source or unavailable anchor stays unknown, not cash. Sparse intermediate absent aggregates may indicate no qualifying trade; report coverage and observed-path limits.
prior_close_basis: Require verified split metadata coverage for previous-to-current session; mark split crossings unavailable instead of inventing adjustments. Other corporate actions remain a nominal-price limitation.
prespecified_scope: No threshold search, best-time selection, new model fit, production changes, automatic buy rule or pooling 342 research dates twice. Analysis uses frozen existing scores and new historical price reads.

source_open_consistency.rule: Compare official raw daily open with first regular-minute open. Absolute relative disagreement above1% marks the session unavailable for both anchors; preserve every measured difference and source identity. Never rescale prices to force agreement.
